name: Meganobz
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 2nd unit 70 pts for 2 models / 105 pts for 3 models / 175 pts for 5 models / 210 pts for 6 models; 3rd+ unit 110 pts for 2 models / 145 pts for 3 models / 215 pts for 5 models / 250 pts for 6 models.
_composition_note: Printed as: 2-6 Meganob models. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Kustom Shoota; 1 Power Klaw.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.

ranged.name: Kombi-weapon - Shoota
ranged.weaponGroupLabel: Before selecting targets with this weapon, select one of its profiles to make attacks with.

ranged.name: Kustom Shoota - Aimed
ranged.weaponGroupLabel: Before selecting targets with this weapon, select one of its profiles to make attacks with.

_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: Any number of models can each have their Power Klaw replaced with 1 Killsaw. | Any number of models can each have their Kustom Shoota replaced with 1 Kombi-weapon. | Any number of models can each have their Power Klaw and Kustom Shoota replaced with 1 Twin Killsaws. Costs: per Killsaw = 5, per Twin Killsaws = 5 pts. 'Any number of models can each' is per: 1. The three options share the unit's Power Klaws and Kustom Shootas, so together they can never swap out more than the unit has.

whileCalled.text: +1 to Hit rolls in the Fight phase
